subtitle: When the Sky Became a Calculated Circle

panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of Nilakantha on a temple rooftop under a star-filled Kerala sky
panels.action: Nilakantha Somayaji stands on the tiled roof of a Kerala temple-house at night, palm leaves swaying around him as he gazes upward, one hand raised towards a dome of bright stars and wandering planets.

dialogue.text: In fifteenth-century Kerala, Nilakantha Somayaji watched the planets with a scholar’s eye, and quietly moved them around the Sun without moving the Earth.

i18n.hi: पंद्रहवीं सदी के केरल में नीलकंठ सोमयाजी ने विद्वान नज़र से ग्रह देखे, और चुपचाप उन्हें सूरज के चारों घूमाया, बिना धरती हिलाए

panels.shot: quiet interior mid-shot, low-angle from floor looking up at a young boy
panels.action: A young Nilakantha sits cross-legged on a polished wooden floor in a Kerala illam, lit by an oil lamp, copying neat Sanskrit letters onto palm leaves while elders chant from astronomical texts in the background.

dialogue.text: Born in 1444 at Kelallur Illam near Trikkandiyur, Nilakantha grew up in a house where the sky was recited, measured and revered.

i18n.hi: १४४४ में त्रिकांडीयूर के पास केलल्लूर इल्लम में जन्मे नीलकंठ ऐसे घर में बड़े हुए जहाँ आसमान को गाया, नापा और पूजा जाता था

panels.shot: top-down close-up on hands and manuscripts
panels.action: The camera looks down at Nilakantha’s youthful hands as he presses a stylus into a palm leaf, beside older manuscripts of Aryabhatiya and commentaries stacked neatly, an oil lamp casting steady light.

dialogue.text: He read Aryabhatiya and the classic siddhantas, absorbing a cosmos with Earth at the centre, planets bound by circles and epicycles.

i18n.hi: उन्होंने आर्यभटीय और पुराने सिद्धांत पढ़े, पृथ्वी के केंद्रवाले ब्रह्मांड को अपनाया, ग्रह गोलों और उपगोलों में बँधे हुए

panels.shot: wide evening shot of courtyard observatory, gentle three-quarter angle
panels.action: Nilakantha, now a young man, stands in a traditional courtyard, beside a simple gnomon casting a long shadow, while he sights along a bamboo staff toward the low Sun amid coconut trees.

dialogue.text: But Kerala’s scholars did not only recite. They measured. With shadows and sight-lines, they checked the old numbers against the living sky.

i18n.hi: पर केरल के पंडित सिर्फ पढ़ते नहीं थे, वे नापते भी थे; परछाइयों और नजर की रेखाओं से वे पुराने अंकों को जीते-जागते आसमान से मिलाते थे

panels.shot: medium close-up profile as he peers through a simple sighting device
panels.action: In twilight, Nilakantha peers along a wooden sighting frame, marking the position of a bright planet near the ecliptic, while a palm-leaf record lies open beside him with neat columns of calculations.

dialogue.text: Night after night, Nilakantha tracked Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn, counting degrees, testing tables, feeling small mismatches prickle in his mind.

i18n.hi: रात दर रात नीलकंठ ने बुध, शुक्र, मंगल, बृहस्पति और शनि को देखा, डिग्रियाँ गिनीं, सारणियाँ परखी, मन में चुभती छोटी-छोटी असंगतियाँ महसूस कीं

panels.shot: interior medium shot, candlelit debate with unseen elders implied off-frame
panels.action: Inside a dim library room lined with palm-leaf bundles, Nilakantha sits upright before elders whose faces are half in shadow, gesturing politely toward a manuscript as if pointing out an error.

dialogue.speaker: nilakantha_somayaji
dialogue.text: Revered sirs, the sky strays from these numbers. Should we not ask why?

i18n.hi: आदरणीय सज्जनो, यह आसमान इन अंकों से चूक जाता है। क्या हमें कारण नहीं पूछना चाहिए?

panels.shot: slow push-in on contemplative face, background of hanging palm-leaf bundles
panels.action: Nilakantha sits alone amidst suspended palm-leaf manuscripts, his face lit warmly, eyes distant, as he holds one leaf of Aryabhatiya-bhasya and another freshly inscribed sheet of his own.

dialogue.text: He chose a demanding path: to comment on Aryabhatiya, to write Jyotirmimamsa, and to test inherited astronomy verse by verse against observation.

i18n.hi: उन्होंने कड़ा रास्ता चुना: आर्यभटीय पर टीका लिखना, ज्योतिर्मिमांसा रचना, और विरासत में मिली ज्योतिष को हर श्लोक पर देखने से कसना

panels.shot: wide shot of Kerala landscape under starry sky, Nilakantha small in foreground
panels.action: Under a vast clear sky over paddy fields and palms, Nilakantha is a small figure with a writing board, glancing alternately at the stars and his notes, the Milky Way arching faintly above.

dialogue.text: Aryabhata’s geocentric world remained sacred. The Earth stayed fixed. But for the wandering planets, Nilakantha allowed his geometry to wander further than tradition.

i18n.hi: आर्यभट का भूकेन्द्रित जगत पवित्र ही रहा। धरती अचल रही। पर भटकते ग्रहों के लिए नीलकंठ ने अपनी रेखागणित को परंपरा से आगे भटकने दिया

panels.shot: diagrammatic over-the-shoulder shot of his drawn orbit scheme on palm leaf
panels.action: Over Nilakantha’s shoulder, we see a palm leaf filled with circles: a central Earth, a Sun circling it, and other planet circles drawn around the Sun, his stylus hovering as he adjusts a curve.

dialogue.text: He imagined a Sun that circled Earth, yet carried Mercury and Venus with it, and placed Mars, Jupiter and Saturn in paths tied to the Sun’s own journey.

i18n.hi: उन्होंने ऐसा सूरज सोचा जो पृथ्वी के चारों घूमे, पर बुध और शुक्र को साथ लिए, और मंगल, बृहस्पति, शनि को सूरज की ही यात्रा से बँधे पथों में रखा

panels.shot: tight close-up on his hand drawing careful arcs and annotating angles
panels.action: Nilakantha’s hand carefully inscribes angular values beside the small orbital circles, precise numerals and Sanskrit abbreviations, while his fingers bear ink stains from long hours of work.

dialogue.text: Planet by planet, he refined their equations, making computed longitudes match the observed sky more closely than older siddhantas could.

i18n.hi: एक-एक ग्रह के लिए उन्होंने समीकरण तराशे, ताकि गिने गए दीर्घांश, देखे गए आसमान से पुराने सिद्धांतों से बढ़कर मेल खाएँ

panels.shot: interior wide shot of writing desk piled with manuscripts, night turning to dawn
panels.action: Nilakantha sits at a low desk, surrounded by palm-leaf stacks labeled Tantrasangraha, verses neatly lined, as dawn light seeps in and the oil lamp fades.

dialogue.text: Around 1500, he wove his work into Tantrasangraha—four hundred and thirty-two verses of planetary theory, spherical astronomy and subtle series calculations.

i18n.hi: करीब १५०० में उन्होंने अपना काम तंत्रसंग्रह में पिरोया—चार सौ बत्तीस श्लोकों की ग्रह-तत्व, गोल-ज्योतिष और सूक्ष्म श्रेणी-गणना की बुनाई

panels.shot: medium shot of him inscribing a chronogram verse, slight low angle
panels.action: Nilakantha leans in, inscribing a special Sanskrit verse on a palm leaf, his expression satisfied, while a small notation of Kali-day lies on a separate reference board beside him.

dialogue.text: He marked his time with chronograms and reckoned Kali days, anchoring his achievement to specific years instead of leaving it to vague tradition.

i18n.hi: उन्होंने युगसूचक शब्दों से समय दर्ज किया, कलि-दिनों का हिसाब रखा, अपनी उपलब्धि को धुंधली परंपरा पर नहीं, खास सालों पर टिकाया

panels.shot: scholarly gathering wide shot in a temple hall, seated circle
panels.action: In a temple hall with carved wooden pillars, Nilakantha sits among fellow scholars, explaining a diagram laid out on the floor, while others listen, some curious, some cautious.

dialogue.speaker: nilakantha_somayaji
dialogue.text: The Earth stands still, as taught. Yet the Sun can bear the planets and still honour our scriptures.

i18n.hi: धरती तो शास्त्रानुसार अचल ही है। पर सूरज ग्रहों को ढो सकता है और फिर भी हमारे धर्मग्रंथों का मान रख सकता है

panels.shot: close-up on two scholars’ faces, one skeptical, one thoughtful, Nilakantha blurred behind
panels.action: Two older scholars in the foreground exchange glances—one frowning, one intrigued—as behind them Nilakantha continues his calm explanation, his figure softly out of focus.

dialogue.text: His model did not assault geocentric cosmology. It revised it from within, balancing reverence and innovation so his new orbits could be heard.

i18n.hi: उनका मॉडल भूकेन्द्रित सृष्टि पर हमला नहीं था; भीतर से संशोधन था, श्रद्धा और नयापन का संतुलन था, ताकि नई कक्षाएँ सुनी जा सकें

panels.shot: montage-style wide shot: overlay of sky and geometric diagram
panels.action: A blended image shows Nilakantha’s orbit diagram overlaid on a real starry sky, planets slipping along their paths as his circles and angles align with their positions.

dialogue.text: Modern readers see in his geometry a pattern later echoed in Tycho’s model: planets circling the Sun, the Sun circling a central Earth.

i18n.hi: आज के पाठक उनकी रेखागणित में वही पैटर्न देखते हैं जो बाद में टाइको के मॉडल में दिखा: ग्रह सूरज के चारों, सूरज स्थिर धरती के चारों

panels.shot: medium shot of aged Nilakantha writing Siddhanta-darpana, serene front angle
panels.action: An older Nilakantha, hair streaked with grey, sits serenely as he writes Siddhanta-darpana, noting the Kali-date carefully while the room around him shows years of accumulated manuscripts.

dialogue.text: In Siddhanta-darpana he recorded his own date—Kali-day 1,660,181—fixing his life between 1444 and the years that followed, an unusual precision in Indian scholarly memory.

i18n.hi: सिद्धांत-दर्पण में उन्होंने अपनी तारीख खुद दर्ज की—कलि-दिन १६६०१८१—जिससे उनका जीवन १४४४ और आगे के बरसों के बीच सटीक ठिकाने पर बैठता है, जो भारतीय विद्वान-स्मृति में दुर्लभ है

panels.shot: wide shot of Kerala coastline with temples, Nilakantha ghostlike figure in sky
panels.action: Over the Kerala coastline, with temple spires and palm groves, a faint, symbolic image of Nilakantha’s face emerges in the sky amid planetary paths traced as luminous arcs.

dialogue.text: Around him, Kerala’s network of mathematicians continued to refine series and astronomy, building quietly on the foundations he had set down.

i18n.hi: उनके आसपास केरल का गणितज्ञ-जाल शृंखलाओं और ज्योतिष को सँवारता रहा, चुपचाप उन नींवों पर इमारत उठाता रहा जो वे रख गए थे

panels.shot: interior close-up of a modern scholar’s hands opening Tantrasangraha manuscript, Nilakantha’s portrait in background
panels.action: In a modern archive setting, a scholar’s hands gently unfold a preserved palm-leaf manuscript of Tantrasangraha, while a respectful portrait of Nilakantha hangs blurred in the background.

dialogue.text: Centuries later, editors and historians like K.V. Sarma and Ramasubramanian traced his verses, rediscovered his planetary scheme and measured its closeness to later European models.

i18n.hi: सदियों बाद के. वी. सरमा और रामसुब्रमणियन जैसे संपादकों और इतिहासकारों ने उनके श्लोकों का पीछा किया, उनकी ग्रह-रचना दुबारा खोजी और देखा कि वह बाद के यूरोपीय मॉडल से कितनी नज़दीक बैठती है

panels.shot: final epic wide shot of star-filled sky above Kerala, camera looking straight up
panels.action: The camera gazes straight up into a deep night sky above Kerala, planets and the Sun suggested as glowing points on graceful orbits, while the land below lies in still darkness.

dialogue.text: Nilakantha Somayaji’s legacy endures as a lesson that even within a cherished tradition, a patient mind can redraw the heavens and make them fit the world more truly.

i18n.hi: नीलकंठ सोमयाजी की विरासत आज भी याद दिलाती है कि प्रिय परंपरा के भीतर भी धीरज से सोचने वाला मन आकाश को नए सिरे से खींच सकता है, और उसे दुनिया से ज़्यादा सच्चा मिला सकता है

title_i18n.en: Nilakantha Moves the Planets Around the Sun
title_i18n.hi: नीलकंठ ने ग्रहों को सूरज के चारों तरफ घुमाया

subtitle_i18n.en: When the Sky Became a Calculated Circle
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब आसमान बना हिसाब से खिंचा गोल
